title: Subcontractors
subtitle: Who builds with you, what you assigned them and what they invoice you.

dir.empty.hint: They're created in Users, with the subcontractor role. Once one exists you'll be able to assign them jobs from here.

dir.noMatch.hint: We search by name and by username.

dir.error.hint: Check your connection and try again.

assign.title: Assign job
assign.jobTitleHint: This is what they'll see in their app. Max {{max}}
assign.footNote: It'll reach their app as a notification
assign.refError.title: We couldn't fetch the lists.
assign.refError.hint: Without subcontractors and jobsites there is no job to assign. Try again.
assign.noSubs.hint: There is no user with the subcontractor role. They're created in Users.
assign.error.subcontractor: Pick who the job goes to.
assign.error.title: Write a title: it's what they'll see in their app.
assign.error.amount: Enter an amount above zero, or leave it empty.
assign.error.server: We couldn't assign the job. Try again.
chg.title: Change status
chg.warning: This change skips the normal flow: the subcontractor can only move forward step by step, you can move it anywhere. It's recorded in the history under your name.
chg.reopenWarning.title: You're reopening a closed job.
chg.reopenWarning.body: It counts as open again and the subcontractor can keep uploading evidence and invoices. Invoices already paid don't change.
chg.error.pick: Pick which status it moves to.
chg.error.server: We couldn't change the status. Try again.
chg.means.ASSIGNED: Back to the start, as if it had never begun.
chg.means.IN_PROGRESS: Hands it back to them without marking it as needing changes.
chg.means.IN_REVIEW: Puts it back in the queue for your approval.
chg.means.OBSERVED: Marks that something needs fixing. Say what in the comment.
chg.means.APPROVED: You accept the job. They'll be able to invoice it.
chg.means.CLOSED: You archive it. It stops counting as open.
chg.reopenMeans.IN_PROGRESS: Hands it back to them. The usual choice when reopening.
chg.reopenMeans.OBSERVED: Reopen while pointing out what needs fixing.
rev.title: Invoice {{number}}
rev.decisionHint: Approving makes it ready to pay. Sending back returns it for fixes.
rev.commentHint: The subcontractor sees it in their app and can correct and resubmit. Max {{max}}
rev.error.comment: You need a comment to send it back.
rev.error.server: We couldn't save your review. Try again.
rev.reviewed.title: {{status}} · {{date}}
rev.reviewed.body: You've already reviewed this invoice. It's waiting for payment.
rev.reviewedObserved.body: You've already sent it back. It's waiting for the subcontractor to fix and resubmit it from their app.
rev.noFile.title: This invoice has no file.
rev.noFile.hint: It was submitted without a PDF. Approve it anyway or ask for the file.
pay.title: Record payment
pay.note: This records the payment with today's date: it doesn't move money. You make the transfer through your bank, as always.
pay.error.title: We couldn't record the payment.
pay.error.hint: Nothing was saved. Check your connection and try again.
